about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling journey to the sun-drenched shores of El Zafiro, a small town on the Caribbean island of St. Silas that is rich with ancient secrets and hidden dangers. In Sensual Adventures - Treasure Island , you'll dive into a open-world RPG experience where action, exploration, the undead and romance collide in a tropical setting.

Play as Brittany or Trinity, intrepid treasure hunters whose quest is entwined with the island's mysterious curse and the enigmatic legacy of the lost Xu’natsa civilization.

Investigate ruins shrouded in legend, unravel challenging but fun puzzles, and battle against the undead. From reanimated pirate skeletons to ancient guardians that haunt the halls of sacred temples and forgotten dungeons.

  • Third-Person Action: Face dynamic combat challenges as you wield weapons and navigate treacherous dungeons. Enemies drop ammo according to your needs, ensuring every fight is tense and rewarding, and if you run out, a well-placed melee attack brings relief!,

  • Intricate Exploration: Discover three awe-inspiring temples, each themed to the unique culture and myths of the Xu’natsa: the Temple of the Warrior, Prophecy, and Healing. Each location brims with traps, environmental puzzles, and history waiting to be uncovered.,

  • Immersive Storytelling: Piece together the fate of an ancient people, battle the restless undead, and unlock the mysteries behind legendary treasures. Experience a compelling narrative full of twists, betrayals, and unexpected allies as you try to break the island's ancient curse.,

  • Complex Character Dynamics: Form relationships with quirky townsfolk, fearless adventurers, and even rival treasure hunters. Navigate a nuanced life with choices that affect your journey and the fate of those around you.,

  • Puzzle-Filled Dungeons: Test your cunning and reflexes. Traverse deadly traps, scale walls, swim through natural springs, and seek out clever solutions to earn your prize.,

Your adventure will take you from bustling local villages to the depths of haunted temples. Outwit Alexandra and her mercenary thugs, confront hulking pirate bosses, and discover lost artifacts, as each step brings you closer to the secrets of the Xu’natsa.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains characters wearing revealing outfits and features stylized combat with Zombie sequences that may include mild violence and brief depictions of blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: INTEL i5, AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060, AMD RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 11
  • Processor: Intel i7 12700, AMD Ryzen 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080, AMD RX 6900 XT
  • Storage: 6 MB available space

short_description: On a mysterious island where people keep disappearing, in this open-world RPG Brittany and friends must investigate ancient ruins, fight zombies, find treasure in dangerous dungeons, and save the people of El Zafiro from the curse of Xu’natsa - all while navigating a complex dating life.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
